candidates.text: It should be noted, to begin with, that all legal restrictions which curtail the civil rights of a single racial group are immediately suspect
candidates.speaker: Black

candidates.text: But once a judicial opinion rationalizes such an order to show that it conforms to the Constitution
candidates.speaker: Jackson, dissenting

candidates.text: This exclusion of `all persons of Japanese ancestry, both alien and non-alien,' from the Pacific Coast area
candidates.speaker: Murphy, dissenting
phrases: falls into the ugly abyss of racism

candidates.text: On the contrary, it is the case of convicting a citizen as a punishment for not submitting to imprisonment
candidates.speaker: Roberts, dissenting
phrases: solely because of his ancestry, without evidence or inquiry concerning his loyalty

candidates.text: Compulsory exclusion of large groups of citizens from their homes, except under circumstances of direst emergency
candidates.speaker: Black
phrases: power to protect must be commensurate with the threatened danger

notes: Counts for ranks 1-2 from the Nov. 25, 2026 validation table (SIGNATURE_QUOTE_METHOD.md); others searched Nov. 25, 2026. Murphy and Roberts tie at 2; Murphy placed third by judgment.
